label: Glitch Safety Organ
purpose: Applies restrained channel offsets, jitter, and distortion rules so futuristic glitch text stays readable and does not become messy or inaccessible.
rules: Glitch is for display, reward, HUD, and banner text—not dense body text.
Reduced motion disables animated jitter and leaves only static channel split or none.
Small text should use minimal or zero offset.
Readable core must remain clean underneath the glitch layer.
